movelist.name: Attract
movelist.effect: Attract Infatuates the target if its gender is the opposite of the user’s. Attract fails when used by or against Genderless targets.

movelist.name: Water Pulse
movelist.effect: Water Pulse Confuses the target on 17+.

movelist.name: Lucky Chant
movelist.effect: Blessing – Any user affected by Lucky Chant may activate it when receiving a Critical Hit to cause the attack to instead deal damage as if it was not a Critical Hit. Lucky Chant may be activated 3 times, and then disappears.

movelist.name: Draining Kiss
movelist.effect: After the target takes damage, the user gains Hit Points equal to half of the damage they dealt to the target.

movelist.name: Agility
movelist.effect: Raise the user’s Speed 2 Combat Stages.

abilities.name: Water Veil
abilities.effect: The user is immune to Burns. Defensive.

abilities.name: Swift Swim
abilities.effect: While in Rainy Weather or under 50% Max Hit Points, the user’s Initiative is doubled.
